fields.why: The four race/ethnicity groups are ranked with 'Other observed differences were not statistically significant', implying every pair was tested with no single referent; the Asian subgroups carry the same statement, so they are tested pairwise too, not side by side. No referent group is named, so 'per-group vs referent only' does not fit.

brief_issues: QuickStats ranking with a blanket 'other differences not significant' line recurs; the brief could state that it reads as pairwise (all pairs).
